Implement GitHub issue https://github.com/softwaremill/sttp/issues/3066 ("CurlBackend: errors lose libcurl's message and code").

Problem: in core/src/main/scalanative/sttp/client4/curl/AbstractCurlBackend.scala, when a curl transfer fails the exception message is only `s"Command failed with status ${curlCode.getOrElse(code)}"`. `CurlOption.ErrorBuffer` exists but is never set, so libcurl's own error text is lost. E.g. a self-signed cert and a wrong-host cert both yield `java.io.IOException: Command failed with status SSL_CACERT`, while curl itself reports "SSL certificate OpenSSL verify result: self-signed certificate (18)" vs "SSL: no alternative certificate subject name matches target hostname ...". Also `CurlCode` uses libcurl's pre-7.62 names: code 60 (today: any peer certificate verification failure) is named `SSL_CACERT`, and code 51 holds the name 60 should have.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Set `CURLOPT_ERRORBUFFER` (CurlOption.ErrorBuffer) per request, with a buffer of CURL_ERROR_SIZE (256) bytes, allocated so it stays valid for the whole transfer and is freed afterwards (follow the existing memory management patterns in the curl backend; no leaks).
2. On failure, the exception message includes the numeric libcurl code, sttp's name for it, and libcurl's error-buffer text when non-empty (fall back to curl_easy_strerror text or just the code/name if the buffer is empty). Keep the existing mapping of curl codes to sttp exception types (from #3046) unchanged.
3. Rename CurlCode entries 51 and 60 to libcurl's current names (51 = PEER_FAILED_VERIFICATION -> check current libcurl naming: 51 is now CURLE_OBSOLETE51 / formerly PEER_FAILED_VERIFICATION; 60 is CURLE_PEER_FAILED_VERIFICATION). Verify against libcurl's curl.h and update any references (including error-type mapping) accordingly.
4. Add/adjust tests for the Scala Native curl backend where feasible (e.g. message formatting unit test); the project's existing test layout under core/src/test/scalanative should be followed.
5. Code must compile for Scala Native: `sbt "compileScoped 3 Native"` and `sbt "compileScoped 2.13 Native"`; run relevant native tests with `sbt "testScoped 3 Native"` if the environment allows (curl native tests may need libcurl dev headers installed).

Keep the change minimal and focused on the issue.
